item.title: Writing
item.description:
I’m in the middle of writing a very long report about the climate of the North Atlantic.

When I was younger, I used to enjoy writing almost as much as reading. Producing essays for physics lessons in school, I would employ all of the sentence structures, grammatical delights and archaic oddities I had found in the works of Jane Austen, or Charles Dickens, as well as in the writing of old scientists like Darwin. Somehow it never seemed to matter that the result read somewhat oddly to the modern eye.

item.title: A Beginning
item.description:
Hello and welcome to my blog.

That was directed as much at me as it is at you.

I have no idea what I am going to end up writing here. I have no idea if there will be anything worth reading. I don’t even know if I want anyone to read it.

I have set two rules.

First, something must be written here at least once every day. This is likely to be mainly just an interesting encounter or a thought that has come into my head, but may end up including longer and more interesting content. We will see.
